answer: Lock work history for 30 days before any of it can be spent. Each receipt carries a sequence number and a timestamp, and a replay of either is caught by the ledger rather than by a name check. A replay claws back 100 percent of the reward plus 10 percent, and resets the history to zero. Three missing sequences in a row is the signal that flags the account. A farm of 1,000 aliases needs 1,000 distinct histories, each 30 days deep, before a single marble can be withdrawn; the voyage to that state is priced in months, not in a funded wallet.
